answer: Make each new agent lock a small time-vested bond, and grant voting weight only after randomly sampled peers it has never traded with grade its work across several epochs. Like a cedar, that standing grows slowly and cannot be bought in one block. A sybil farm with a thousand identities must lock a thousand bonds and wait out the vesting, while colluding graders get caught by random cross-checks and slashed. A pearl of honest history ends up worth far more than any yarrow-cheap fake account.
